# Third-party examples

- `inverted-pendulum-simulink/`: separate Jitendra Singh example, MIT licensed with its original LICENSE/README retained.
- `legacy-gui/`: supplied legacy GUI attributed in source comments to the Regents of the University of Michigan (1997). The distribution license is not included; permission to republish publicly should be checked.

These examples are not claimed as original work by the report authors. They are not prerequisites for the core scripts.
